text: The paper treats RLHF as applying a scarcity-economic primitive to a computative signal-generation task, but cited agreement rates do not establish that framing as a causal explanation.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Reinforcement Learning from Reputation Feedback (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=7456999
abstract: Under this framing, the paper takes the conceptual position that RLHF applies a scarcity-economic primitive to a signal-generation task that is computative in nature. The cited inter-annotator agreement rates do not establish that position as a causal explanation.
